official_sources.name: OS future British mapping coordinate systems

direct_official_checks: OSGB36 and ODN remain the basis of OS mapping
OSTN15 transforms ETRS89 to OSGB36 National Grid
OSGM15 provides access to ODN height from GNSS context
OS Net is used with these transformations for coordinate access
ODN benchmark network has not been maintained since the 1970s
benchmark movement or subsidence can introduce additional error
mining areas can experience benchmark subsidence of several metres
horizontal transformation and vertical terrain-model error must be kept as separate uncertainty terms
quality_effect: Separates horizontal positioning, vertical datum and legacy benchmark risks from terrain surface uncertainty.
